text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D4","page":1,"quote":"14"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D5","page":1,"quote":"9"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D6","page":1,"quote":"8"}],"comment":"The stepped shaft diameters (D4, D5, D6) carry no fit or tolerance callouts, leaving mating features undefined. Without specified fits the assembler cannot determine whether these steps are bearing seats, locating journals, or clearance surfaces, risking improper assembly. The designer should add appropriate ISO fit designations or explicit tolerances to each functional diameter.","recommended_correction":"Add fit or tolerance callouts (e.g., h6, H7, or explicit limits) to dimensions D4, D5, and D6 as required by their mating function."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"13 (-0.2/-0.1)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"ELECTOLESS NICKEL PLATING"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 has a tolerance band of 0.1 mm on a part that is electroless nickel plated, but the drawing does not state whether the dimension is before or after plating. Plating buildup can push this tight feature out of tolerance, causing assembly interference. The designer should specify if D1 is a pre-plate or post-plate dimension and adjust the nominal size or tolerance to allow for the plating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Clarify on the drawing whether D1 applies before or after plating, and adjust the nominal value or tolerance band to accommodate the electroless nickel deposit."}]}
